title: Was Hoping for a Ruged Camp Towel
text: Was Hoping for a Ruged Camp Towel. This towel is OK.  IT is a little weird to have a waffle beach towel and it seems to have brought most of the shortcomings of the waffle fabric to the job.  It definitely is not as absorbant as a terry cloth towel would have been and it did not wash as well as other towels would have.  The seams bunched funny after drying and deformed the shape a bit as well as minor fraying after just one wash and dry cycle.  What it did do as well as we hoped was pack small, but that is not going to be enough to get it a place in our backpacks.  We have since picked up some great chamois style camp towels that are super absorbant, fast drying and packable.  This will probably be relegate to be a very large cleaning rag.

product_metadata.title: WHITEWRAP Waffle Towels | Premium Cotton Bath Towel | Ultra Absorbent Soft Lint Free Quick Dry Lightweight Bath Sheet |Hot Coral| 28x55 inch
features: ✅ LIGHTWEIGHT & ABSORBENT: If you prefer a plush, thick bath towel, we recommend shopping our classic bath towel instead. The waffle towel is like nothing you’ve used before, it’s incredibly lightweight and breathable with an exfoliating texture which makes for a refreshingly new drying experience.

✅ DRIES QUICKLY & REMAINS FRESH: The larger surface area of the honeycomb-style pockets makes the waffle bath towel dry faster. With more air passing through the waffle weave, waffle towels dry up to 50% faster and stay fresher than standard towels, even in humid environments.

✅ MODERN LOOK & LUXURY: This Bath towel is loomed from luxuriously soft organic cotton and continues to get softer with use. Extra-long cotton fibers create an amazing soft bath towel that is more luxurious, vibrant, and durable to remain a treasured bathroom luxury for years to come.

✅ SUPER ABSORBENT BLANKET + TOWEL ALL IN ONE: Warm enough to be a blanket, Absorbent enough to be a towel. Eco-friendly. Made from Organic Cotton. Generously oversized at 28x55” before washing (expect 12-15% shrinkage).
✅ ECO FRIENDLY & MADE WITH CARE: Defoliant Free Pure Cotton and OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Certified (Meets High International Standards for Environmentally Responsible Manufacturing).
